## Security fix: crafted .xls and .xlsb files

A spreadsheet in the old `.xls` or `.xlsb` format, crafted for it, could make
Xylem 0.6.0 crash or try to take gigabytes of memory when opened in the viewer,
or in Autoview just by passing over the file. The cause was in calamine, the
library that reads spreadsheets
([RUSTSEC-2026-0436](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0436)); its
version 0.38 bounds both, and this release uses it. The weekly `cargo audit` in
CI found the advisory.

Nothing else changes from 0.6.0. If you browse folders with spreadsheets you
did not create, update; until then, keep Autoview (F7) closed there.

## Install

Download the archive for your system below (Linux x86_64 or ARM64, static;
Windows x86_64), a `.deb` or `.rpm` package, or `cargo install xylem-fm`. The
website: https://andrelnfernandes.github.io/xylem/
